program.section_heading: Associate in Arts for Transfer Degree Major Requirements
outcomes: Explain the process of socialization in terms of human development in different social contexts and societies.

Develop appropriate research questions, design well-developed research projects at the undergraduate level, and effectively apply empirical methods to the study of society, generating well-evidenced, rational explanations for social outcomes, phenomena, practices, and processes.
Describe how social structures of class, culture, gender, race, and sexuality affect life changes.
Critically analyze and explain the relationship between individual behavior and society.

notes: SOCI 19, SOCI 3 and SOCI 13 are printed as cross-listed codes (SOCI/PSYC 19, SOCI/PSYC 3, SOCI/ETNC 13); the PSYC/ETNC codes are recorded as alternatives.
STAT C1000 is printed as an 'or' option to SOCI/PSYC 19 with no units beside it; units left null.
List B also allows 'Any List A course not already selected'; those courses are recorded only once, in List A.
Units are printed only for the List A and List B block totals (6 and 3), not beside individual courses in those lists.

'Additional Requirements 41' covers Cal-GETC and electives together ('Complete Cal-GETC pattern and electives, if needed, for a total of 60 transferable units'); it is not recorded as ge_units because it is not a GE-only figure.
The learning outcomes are printed for the AA-T program page and recorded as this award's outcomes.
